extension.news: v1.90.0 - Kodi 23 pre-release. Needs the kontell/xbmc consolidated build of Kodi 23; Omega and Piers stay on 1.x. - Plays through Kodi's music player, with Kodi's own tempo. inputstream.tempo is no longer needed. - New: chapters in the player, on the seek bar and in Kodi's chapter list. Next and Previous go chapter by chapter, then on to the next file. - New: books in several files play as one, without a gap between files. - New: Chapters, under Now playing, lists the whole book's chapters and goes to any of them, in another file too. - New: Play from the start, on the context menu of a book in progress. - Speed changed from the player's OSD is remembered for the book. - Resume lands where the server says, even 40 hours into a single file. - Removed: the speed step, minimum and maximum settings (the range is now Kodi's, 0.5 to 5), and the Koshelf.* window properties. - Known: the narrator now leads the description, and author photos appear only as the artist art.
extension.description: Browse and play audiobooks and podcasts from your AudioBookShelf server

extension.news: v0.96.3 - Library nodes and playlists are off unless switched on. - Play counts and watched marks reach the library faster. - Downloads no longer slow Kodi down on slow storage. - Kodi's "Ignore video extras on scan" setting is left as it is. - Settings reorganised.
extension.summary: Jellyfin client for seamless Kodi integration
extension.description: Play movies, shows & music from a Jellyfin server.

extension.news: v23.18.3 - Close live streams on the server when a tune never starts playing - Fix a race between reconnecting and requests already in flight - Channel changes on the server reach Kodi after a reload or reconnect - Retry connecting when the server answers before it can log in - Declare the Python dependency of the add-on's scripts - Ship the license and the JsonCpp notice in the add-on - Kodi reports a timer the server refused, instead of showing it as set - Server discovery skips malformed replies instead of stopping - Connecting loads the channels once, not twice - Kodi keeps its channels and their settings when the first connect fails - Another PVR add-on's playback is no longer reported to Jellyfin as this add-on's - A channel Kodi plays at startup is reported to Jellyfin - The Quick Connect prompt no longer lists example clients
extension.summary: Kodi PVR client for Jellyfin Live TV
extension.description: Kodi PVR integration for Jellyfin Live TV. Provides live TV channels, EPG, recordings, and timers from a Jellyfin server.

extension.news: v22.90.0 - A pre-release for Kodi 23, in development. Versions now follow Kodi's add-on numbering, where 22.90 comes before 23. - Synced with Estuary from Kodi 23's development branch. The home screen and Contuary widgets are unchanged. - Media flag icons take the theme's accent colour, and the dots between details are dimmed. - Video OSD: rewind and fast forward seek while paused, rather than resuming playback. - Slideshow: shows each picture's date and time when Kodi's setting for it is on. - Volume: the passthrough icon shows the level when Kodi's passthrough volume control is on. - Games: the achievements settings gain a hardcore mode toggle. - PVR: the channel OSD's heading names the provider and group it was opened from. - Video versions: labels and icons are correct when versions are flattened into the library. - Song lists show how far into a song you are, for add-ons that give songs a resume point. - Home: the music categories row starts with Restore playlist. - Music OSD: a play speed button. - These three need Kodi changes that are not in Kodi 23 yet (kontell/xbmc #24, #22 and #15). Without them the song progress and the play speed button stay hidden, and Restore playlist does nothing.
extension.summary: Contuary - A light mod of Estuary for Kodi 23
extension.description: Contuary is a lightly modified version of the default Estuary skin. A pre-release for Kodi 23, based on its Estuary while it is in development.
